customer_app.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-white shadow-xl relative pb-24
customer_app.pills: rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-all

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-gray-100 px-4 py-4 flex flex-col justify-center items-center shadow-sm
header.title: text-2xl font-headings font-bold text-primary
header.subtitle: text-xs text-text-secondary font-medium mt-1

category_nav.style: flex overflow-x-auto gap-3 py-4 px-4 scrollbar-hide no-scrollbar sticky top-[72px] bg-white z-40 border-b border-gray-50

product_card.layout: flex gap-4 p-4 border border-border rounded-2xl mb-4 bg-white active:bg-gray-50 transition-colors
product_card.title: text-lg font-headings font-bold text-text-primary leading-tight
product_card.add_button: h-8 w-8 rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xl

combo_card.layout: relative overflow-hidden p-5 border-2 border-secondary/20 rounded-2xl mb-6 bg-gradient-to-br from-white to-secondary/5
combo_card.badge: absolute top-0 right-0 bg-secondary text-white text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-bl-xl
combo_card.title: text-xl font-headings font-bold text-secondary mb-2

floating_cart.wrapper: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 z-50 flex justify-center pointer-events-none
floating_cart.button: w-full bg-primary text-white rounded-full py-4 px-6 flex justify-between items-center shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(229,57,53,0.3)] hover:bg-primary-hover active:scale-[0.98] transition-all
floating_cart.amount_badge: bg-white text-primary text-sm font-bold h-6 min-w-[24px] px-2 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center

customization_drawer.option_row: flex justify-between items-center py-3 border-b border-gray-100 last:border-0

admin.sidebar: w-64 bg-white border-r border-gray-200 h-screen fixed hidden md:flex flex-col
admin.header: h-16 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white flex items-center justify-between px-6
admin.card: bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
admin.table_th: text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first UI for the customer app, simulating a native app feel within a browser (max-width container, sticky headers/footers).
Use Lucide-React for all icons (e.g., ShoppingBag, Plus, Minus, Settings, Menu).
Implement the floating cart at the bottom with a high z-index and fixed positioning.
Use Shadcn UI for the admin panel (Cards, Tables, Dialogs, Forms). Disable default Shadcn Card styles if they conflict with the custom padding/radii defined here.
For customer-facing forms (like Address and Payment), use Shadcn components but style them with generous padding and large touch targets.
Ensure the WhatsApp redirect logic accurately parses the cart state and formats a clean message.
Do not use transparent headers for the customer app. Use the defined bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl.
Primary action colors (Red) must meet contrast ratios. The white text on #E53935 is accessible.
